label: Coverage 5
definition: Comprehensive declared population, period and states

label: Fitness/relevance 0
definition: Relevance not established, or the item is not linked to the assertion

label: Fitness/relevance 1
definition: Indirect: concerns a related system, population or design generation, not the asserted subject

label: Fitness/relevance 2
definition: Partial: correct subject but a different claim type, configuration version or operating state
criterion: Partial: other claim type, version or state

label: Fitness/relevance 3
definition: Relevant: addresses the asserted subject, claim type and period, and is linked to the assertion

label: Fitness/relevance 4
definition: Specific: addresses the precise assessment criterion, configuration version and declared operating states
criterion: Specific to criterion, version and states

label: Fitness/relevance 5
definition: Discriminating: designed for the criterion (e.g. a test with pre-declared acceptance criteria) so that a nonconforming condition would have been detected

label: Timeliness/currentness 5
definition: Near-real-time or event-current with healthy collection
